releaseNotes:
✨ v2.3.0
- Redesigned session side box with timeline, day navigation, and inline editing
- New sidebar design: single toggle button with overlay (no content push)
- Session name popup: enter name before starting (optional)
- Pomodoro button delay fixes - fully synchronous toggleTimer
- Settings toggle fix: Show popup task on start now works correctly
- Clicking outside session name popup closes it without starting timer
- Updated welcome screen with animated release version
- Various bug fixes and performance improvements
